pla-01.prompt: Flat two-dimensional educational illustration. Simple closed shapes, clear dark outlines, completely solid uniform fills. No gradients, shading or texture. Two separate groups of equally sized BLUE circles. There are only TWO circles on the LEFT and MANY, about twelve, on the right. A single bold red downward pointer arrow directly above points only to the TWO circles in the LEFT group. Clear white gap, whole uniform solid shapes, no people, words, digits or mathematical signs. Single square CACE vocabulary image. Pure white background. Show every subject and essential prop whole inside the middle two thirds of the canvas. Zoom OUT, leave one sixth of canvas width empty at both sides, generous white above and below. Natural anatomically correct hands. Plain shoes and clothing. No border. Absolutely no text, writing, letters, numbers, labels, brand marks, emblems, logos or watermarks anywhere.

alt.ca: Cercles blaus: una fletxa assenyala el grup amb poques peces.
alt.es: Círculos azules: una flecha señala el grupo con pocas piezas.
